name: router-errors
about: 模型请求的各类失败：provider 回 400 / 401 / 429 / 500、连接被拒（模型 baseUrl 指向本机没人监听的 9 端口，按轮 modelOverride 选它）时的事件序列（含重试期间的 agent_status retry_progress）、最终错误文案、会话记录和 router/events.jsonl。重试退避带随机抖动（delayMs），基线自比不稳。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    dead:
      protocol: openai
      url: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        nowhere:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
